[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: String) : String :=
let len := a.length
if a.length ≠ b.length then
  "ERROR"
else
  let rec loop (i: Nat) (result: String) : String :=
    if i = len then result
    else
      let a_char := a.get (String.Pos.mk i)
      let b_char := b.get (String.Pos.mk i)
      let xor_char := if a_char = b_char then '0' else '1'
      loop i.succ (result ++ xor_char.toString)
  loop 0 ""
loop 0 ""
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation a b
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_a_valid := a.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
  have h_b_valid := b.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
  have h_same_length := a.length = b.length
  have h_result_length := result.length = a.length
  have h_result_valid := result.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
  have h_loop_termination := 
    if a.length ≠ b.length then
      by simp [result]
    else
      have h_loop_termination_base_case : loop 0 "" = result := by
        simp [loop]
      h_loop_termination_base_case
  have h_loop_invariant := 
    if a.length ≠ b.length then
      by simp [loop]
    else
      have h_loop_invariant_base_case : loop 0 "" = result := by
        simp [loop]
      h_loop_invariant_base_case
  have h_result_length := 
    if a.length ≠ b.length then
      by simp [result]
    else
      have h_result_length_induction : 
        ∀ i, i < a.length → loop i (result.substr 0 i) = result.substr 0 i := by
        induction' i generalizing result
        simp [loop]
        intro i h_i_lt_len
        simp [loop]
        specialize h_result_length_induction i
        rw [h_result_length_induction]
        have h_i_suc_lt_len : i.succ < a.length := by
          linarith
        simp [h_i_suc_lt_len]
        simp [loop]
        simp [h_result_length_induction]
        rw [h_result_length_induction]
